## Summary

I implemented an optional `return_token_offsets` flag on the completion and chat-completion render endpoints that returns character-level `[start, end]` offset pairs for each prompt token, aligned with the original prompt text.

### Changes

**`vllm/renderers/params.py`** — Added `return_token_offsets: bool = False` to `TokenizeParams`, and preserved it through `with_kwargs()`.

**`vllm/renderers/base.py`** — 
- Added `_can_produce_offsets()` returning `False` by default (overridable).
- Added `_encode_with_offsets()` helper (+ async wrapper `_async_tokenizer_encode_with_offsets`) that uses the tokenizer's `return_offsets_mapping`.
- Updated `_tokenize_prompt` / `_tokenize_prompt_async` to attach `prompt_token_offsets` only when `params.return_token_offsets and self._can_produce_offsets()`.
- Updated `_process_tokens` / `_process_tokens_async` to copy `prompt_token_offsets` into the engine input dict when present.

**`vllm/renderers/hf.py`** — Overrode `_can_produce_offsets()` to return `True` for fast HF tokenizers (`is_fast`).
